component.name: Hyperion
component.summary: Local Windows EXE launcher for Linux

description.p: Hyperion is a focused Linux launcher for local Windows executables. Select an EXE, choose Wine or Proton, configure a prefix, and launch the game.
This Flatpak is distributed as an official prebuilt binary. Sandboxing can limit integrations that depend on externally installed host tools.

ul.li: Per-game executable, arguments, and prefix settings.
